name: NGC 3265 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 3265, a dusty galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc3265-hubble
story: Catalogs list NGC 3265 as an elliptical galaxy, but Hubble's sharp view revealed something messier: faint, diffuse spiral arms laced with dust.

claims.text: NGC 3265 is catalogued as Hubble class E (elliptical)
In Hubble ACS images (F475W and F850LP program) NGC 3265 shows irregular, non-early-type morphology
NGC 3265 has very diffuse spiral arms and is heavily affected by dust
